# Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB)

> AIIB is a multilateral development bank financing sustainable infrastructure projects across Asia and beyond, with a focus on climate finance and regional economic development.

Founded with headquarters in Beijing, AIIB serves as a key financial institution for infrastructure investment and sustainable development in Asia. The bank operates through a governance structure including a Board of Governors and Board of Directors, and maintains strong financial strength with USD 20 billion in paid-in capital.
